tooltip.jaymospowers.head.bola: Wraps and trips whoever it hits, through the bolas' own cord.
tooltip.jaymospowers.head.net: Bursts into a net where it lands and roots everything near for a few seconds.
tooltip.jaymospowers.head.caltrop: Scatters caltrops where it lands: they cut and slow whoever steps on them.
tooltip.jaymospowers.head.harpoon: Drags what it hits toward you on a line.
tooltip.jaymospowers.head.grapple: Where it sticks, it pulls you.
tooltip.jaymospowers.head.smoke: Bursts into a cloud that hides you; mobs inside lose their target.
tooltip.jaymospowers.head.flare: Lights and marks the ground where it lands: everything near glows for fifteen seconds.
tooltip.jaymospowers.head.whistle: Shrieks where it lands and calls every mob in earshot to the spot.
tooltip.jaymospowers.head.barbed: Barbs that open a bleeding cut.
tooltip.jaymospowers.head.broadhead: Hits much harder, but flies slower and drops sooner.
tooltip.jaymospowers.head.flash: A blinding flash where it lands.
tooltip.jaymospowers.head.drill: Pierces a second target, and goes through a raised shield.
tooltip.jaymospowers.head.boomerang: Comes back to your hand if it misses.
tooltip.jaymospowers.throwable.smoke_pot: A clay pot of stinging smoke. It breaks where it lands and chokes and blinds whoever stands in the cloud.
tooltip.jaymospowers.throwable.flash_pow: A twist of powder that goes off in a blinding flash where it lands.
tooltip.jaymospowers.throwable.sneezing_: Breathed in, it makes mobs lose their target and stumble, and shakes a player out of whatever they were holding ready.
tooltip.jaymospowers.throwable.bleeding_: An iron-tipped dart that opens a bleeding cut.
tooltip.jaymospowers.throwable.acid_vial: Splashes a pool that eats the armour of everyone in it.
tooltip.jaymospowers.throwable.choking_v: A vial of heavy gas: a cloud that sickens, weakens and slows whoever breathes it.
tooltip.jaymospowers.throwable.caltrops: Scatters iron spikes that cut and slow whoever steps on them.
tooltip.jaymospowers.throwable.bear_trap: Set where it lands: it snaps shut on the first thing to step near it and holds it fast.
tooltip.jaymospowers.head.fit: Fit to %s plain arrows at the Fletching Station.
tooltip.jaymospowers.head.kept: Stays in the arrow: pick it up again.
tooltip.jaymospowers.throwable.belt: Throw it from the hand, or keep it in a belt of throwables.
tooltip.jaymospowers.thrower_belt.how: Click throwables onto it to load it; right-click it onto an empty slot to take the picked ones out.
jei.jaymospowers.arrowhead_fitting.how: At the Fletching Station: arrows in the first slot, the head in the second.
jei.jaymospowers.thrower_belt: Worn in the belt slot. Click throwables onto it to load it. Cycle the picked kind with one key and throw it with another (set both in Controls).
